s1.syndrome_frame: intermittent abdominal pain with gastrointestinal bleeding and a mass in the small intestine
salient_findings: exophytic ileal mass with mesenteric lymphadenopathy
key_facts: normal white blood cell and platelet counts
focal segment of small-bowel wall thickening on magnetic resonance enterography
exophytic ileal mass with mesenteric lymphadenopathy on exploratory laparotomy
polypoid, tan-white, lobulated mass on gross examination
transmural, infiltrative proliferation of uniform epithelioid and spindle cells on microscopic examination
diffuse, strong positivity for S100 protein and SOX10 on immunohistochemical analysis

raw.syndrome_frame: intermittent abdominal pain with gastrointestinal bleeding and a mass in the small intestine
salient_findings: exophytic ileal mass with mesenteric lymphadenopathy
key_facts: normal white blood cell and platelet counts
focal segment of small-bowel wall thickening on magnetic resonance enterography
exophytic ileal mass with mesenteric lymphadenopathy on exploratory laparotomy
polypoid, tan-white, lobulated mass on gross examination
transmural, infiltrative proliferation of uniform epithelioid and spindle cells on microscopic examination
diffuse, strong positivity for S100 protein and SOX10 on immunohistochemical analysis

differentials: Clear cell sarcoma-like tumor of the gastrointestinal tract
per_call: Clear cell sarcoma-like tumor of the gastrointestinal tract

shortlist.label: Gastrointestinal stromal tumor
shortlist.why_kept: matches small intestine mass and spindle cell morphology

shortlist.label: Clear cell sarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: matches small intestine location and epithelioid/spindle cell morphology

shortlist.label: Malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor
shortlist.why_kept: matches S100 protein positivity and spindle cell morphology

shortlist.label: Schwannoma
shortlist.why_kept: matches S100 protein positivity and spindle cell morphology

shortlist.label: Gastrointestinal autonomic nerve tumor
shortlist.why_kept: matches small intestine location and spindle cell morphology with S100 protein positivity

raw.rationale: The tumor's strong positivity for S100 protein and SOX10, along with its epithelioid and spindle cell morphology, supports this diagnosis. Clear cell sarcoma is known for its expression of S100 and SOX10, and its presentation as a small intestinal mass with lymphadenopathy is consistent with the case facts.

rejected.label: Gastrointestinal stromal tumor
rejected.why: Negative for CD117, DOG1, and other typical markers of GIST

rejected.label: Malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor
rejected.why: Lack of perineural invasion and less typical morphology for MPNST

rejected.label: Schwannoma
rejected.why: Transmural, infiltrative growth pattern and lymphadenopathy are not typical for schwannoma

rejected.label: Gastrointestinal autonomic nerve tumor
rejected.why: Immunohistochemical profile does not match, and morphology is not characteristic
